newsitem.title: FINLAND: KUNTIEN ASUNTOLUOTTO ISSUES FIM 100 MLN BOND.
newsitem.headline: KUNTIEN ASUNTOLUOTTO ISSUES FIM 100 MLN BOND.

text.p: Finnish municipal mortgage institution Kuntien Asuntoluotto will issue a 100 million markka three-year bond carrying a 4.30 percent coupon to small investors, Kuntien Asuntoluotto said in a statement.
The subscription period will run from October 21 to the end of the year, it said.
The lead manager was for the first time Aktia Bank and Aktia head of treasury Denis Strandell said that this -- Aktia's first ever major external issue -- was in important step for the bank.
"We believe the market for such bonds will develop favourably in the future and that it is natural for Aktia to be involvoed in this kind of activity," Strandell said in a statement from Aktia.
The bond issue was also the first managed by Aktia to be marketed to private investors via the entire network of savings banks.
